title: How to Ace this Course
summary: Short study-habits video at the end of the first module: write down why you are learning to code using the goal-setting worksheet in the next lesson, and keep it visible for when the material gets harder.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: Starting is already progress: many people who buy online courses never begin.
Expect the difficulty to rise later in the course; plan for motivation dips in advance.
Use the goal-setting worksheet (next lesson) to answer: why learn to code, what you want to achieve with the skill, and what life looks like once you have it.
Print the completed sheet and keep it where you study, so you can re-read your reasons when progress stalls.

task.name: Goal-setting worksheet
task.starting_point: The worksheet PDF attached to the following lesson (the reference repo also stores a copy as '02.05 - Goal Setting Questions.pdf').
task.goal: Record personal reasons and goals for learning web development.
steps: Open the worksheet from the next lesson's resources.
Answer each question about your motivation and the outcome you want.
Print it and place it somewhere visible from your study desk.
task.expected_result: A filled-in sheet of goals on display while working through the course.
